name: Beechworth

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Chardonnay and Shiraz sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

blurb.text: A small region in the North East Victoria zone, one of its five named wine regions. Pinot Noir (22 percent) and Chardonnay (21) lead plantings, followed by Shiraz (14) and Pinot Gris (10).
